name: Llucmaçanes Gran
description: An agrotourism stay on the plaça des Pla de Sant Gaietà, the heart of Llucmaçanes — Menorca's smallest village, and one of the few places where you can stay inside a genuine rural hamlet. It is run by its owners, and the accommodation is split between houses, apartments and rooms.

practicalInfo.acceso: Plaça es Pla de Sant Gaietà 10, Llucmaçanes, 07712 Maó.
practicalInfo.horario: The season is not published; confirm 2026 dates on the official site.
